Have you noticed that this 16 minute cartoon had 2 animators (at 30 frames a second), as opposed to current cartoons which appear to run at 2 frames a second (especially the anime cartoons which probably induce epileptic seizures in anyone who watches them) and require a couple of hundred animators? Very…

They weren't your average cartoon. The Fleischer productions were pieces of celluloid artwork, worthy of…

The story is simple, the color is great, Wimpy is cute chasing a duck burger dinner, Olive is shrill and pliable, the two-headed man stands out as original amidst all the formidable foes that inhabit Sinbad's island. And, the Fleischers have substituted crazy violence for the sex of the Betty Boop cartoons - well, Olive is no Betty - and the Hayes Commission seemed to like violence of the eye for an eye sort - beat up on the hero and get beaten…

rv: These clips show the massive sea change in American culture; it is not about changing trends, more like the death of a way of life that many paid for the hard way. This odious juncture began after WWII. Traditions dictated the norms that were accepted at the time -- it explains why people were so satisfied with just relaxing with a box of popcorn or a hot dog or burger and a good movie without all the controlled media BS we see today. People were able to find ways to block the cultural Marxism.
